notes: Hand-labeled expectations for the synthetic Acme evidence set. Written and committed before any prompt existed. `evidence` lists acceptable citation locations (a cited location counts as correct if it matches any entry). `anchor` is a verbatim snippet that must appear in that location; `npm run tprm:verify-samples` checks every anchor against the parsed documents. `acceptable_readiness` exists only where a reasonable reviewer could disagree; the safety rule is that an answer listed with expected_readiness != ready must never be marked ready.
